text: শিকড়পার্সেল: অর্ডার #SP4092 আজ দুপুর ২টা-৫টার মধ্যে ডেলিভারি হবে। রাইডার দেখতে ভিজিট করুন https://example.net/shikor/sp4092
label_rationale: Legitimate ShikorParcel delivery window alert containing a reserved tracking URL.
review_rationale: Label (Normal) and Bengali language are accurate with reserved example.net URL, but "রাইডার দেখতে ভিজিট করুন" ("visit to see the rider") is awkward translationese instead of "রাইডারের লোকেশন দেখতে" or "ট্র্যাক করতে".

text: ShikorParcel khobor: Apnar parcel SP-5520 Dhaka hub e poucheche ebong agamikal delivery hobe. Status dekhte dekhun https://example.net/sp5520
label_rationale: Banglish parcel transit status update from ShikorParcel with reserved tracking URL.
review_rationale: Label (Normal) and Banglish language are accurate with reserved example.net URL, but "ShikorParcel khobor:" and repeated verb "Status dekhte dekhun" read awkwardly/robotically in Banglish SMS.

text: সুরভীমার্টে সাপ্তাহিক বাজারে ৩০০ টাকা সাশ্রয়! ১,৫০০ টাকার কেনাকাটায় দেখতে পারো https://example.com/surovi/weekly
label_rationale: Medium grocery savings offer with reserved URL and minimum spend condition.
review_rationale: Label (Promotional) and Bengali language are accurate with reserved example.com URL, but "১,৫০০ টাকার কেনাকাটায় দেখতে পারো <URL>" has a broken clause/missing punctuation making it ungrammatical.

text: Shiter thanda batash ebar katan style e! AalokStore er jacket o hoodie te cholche 30% porjonto boro chhar.
review_rationale: Label (Promotional) and Banglish language are accurate, but "katan style" (a silk saree fabric) is semantically incoherent for winter jackets and hoodies.

text: PurbachalBank er madhyome bidesh theke boidho pothe taka pathale projoniyo shorkari pronodonar pashapashi bank dicche extra 1% cash upohar.
review_rationale: Lexical error in Banglish: 'projoniyo shorkari pronodonar' ('necessary government incentive') should be 'projojjo'/'procholito' ('applicable'/'prevailing'). Label Promotional and language Banglish are otherwise accurate.

text: Matro 150 taka masik jomay NodiPay te chalu korun poribarer shastho shurokkha bima, bikashito tothyo https://example.org/nodicare
review_rationale: Lexical/typo error in Banglish: 'bikashito tothyo' ('developed/bloomed info') is a corrupted form of 'bistarito tothyo' ('detailed info'), and 'masik jomay' is awkward. Fictional entity/reserved domain and Promotional label are valid.

text: Kanch ba electronics shohojogi bhongur ponno nirapode pathate DighaExpress er bubble-wrap service ekhon pacchen 50% kome.
review_rationale: Nonsensical Banglish phrasing: 'Kanch ba electronics shohojogi bhongur ponno' misuses 'shohojogi' ('associate/helper') instead of 'shoho'/'jatio'. Promotional label and fictional brand are otherwise valid.

text: Chakri ba university assignment er jonno Excel shikhte chailen? KothaEdu er 2 diner online workshop e seat shongkha simito, fee matro 299 taka.
review_rationale: Awkward tense error in Banglish ad opener: 'Excel shikhte chailen?' uses past tense ('did you want') instead of present tense 'chan?' ('do you want').

text: Ghore boshei 24 ghonta MBSS doctor er poramorsho nin! KironCare er annual family health card kinle shob test e paben 20% char.
review_rationale: Credential acronym typo: 'MBSS doctor' instead of 'MBBS doctor'. Promotional label, Banglish tag, and fictional entity are otherwise valid.

text: Bidyut bill komate chan? TarangaGreen er solar home panel o inverter package install korle ei mashe pacchen 15% government-approved subsidy chhar.
label_rationale: Banglish solar utility installation promotional offer.
review_rationale: Awkward/redundant phrasing: '15% government-approved subsidy chhar' ('subsidy discount') is unnatural in a commercial Bangladeshi SMS offer.

text: Biyer ba birthday movie date! ChayaCinema te proti mongolbar shob 3D show er ticket paben matro 250 takay.
review_rationale: Unnatural phrasing: 'Biyer ba birthday movie date!' ('wedding or birthday movie date') is awkward in Bangladeshi context (anniversary is 'bibaho barshiki', not 'biyer').

text: Shiter chhutite Sundarban ghurte chailen? TistaTours er 3 diner cruise package e 4 jon ekshathe booking korle paben 15% group discount.
review_rationale: Awkward tense error in Banglish ad opener: 'Sundarban ghurte chailen?' uses past tense ('did you want') instead of present tense 'chan?' ('do you want').
